column1: # Health readings for examples/dual-plane.dc, to load beside
# dual-plane-flows.tsv (or the load generator) and read as findings:
#   R02/s5   the incast target. It drops packets, and the load says it must:
#            eight senders offer it 80 Gb/s over two 25G NICs.
#   R03/s7   drops packets with its cables well short of full -- loss the
#            load does not explain, which is the one to go and look at.
#   R01/s4   logged soft lockups, and warns.
#   R04/s2   logged a soft lockup and an EDAC error, and fails its check.
# The viewer reads each metric's kind from its name (drops, lockups,
# errors) or from finding= on its !test line; a verdict is any text
# metric with FAIL or WARN in it.
